last_updated_by: Codex WO-044 EHR sandbox integration/writeback queue hardening
notes: WO-044 completed P9 synthetic/browser/API-testable EHR sandbox integration and writeback queue evidence. EHR status/chart-context behavior remains intact, and the API now exposes a metadata-only writeback queue with human approval, idempotency replay, retry, dead-letter, reconciliation, role denial, PHI-key/text rejection, and audit/domain event evidence. The browser route /aura-note/integrations/ehr exposes sandbox queue lifecycle states. No live production EHR credential, raw EHR payload, production patient data, live writeback delivery, autonomous note submission, medical-necessity determination, charge finalization, or claim submission was introduced. Next active work is WO-045 ClinicOS integration hardening.
